warp.bot: REQUIRED first step for any appointment booking. Do not create calendar events directly; that bypasses availability checks, policy rules, and attendee tracking. Collect purpose, preferred time, timezone, and attendee contacts. Convert relative dates to exact ISO datetimes with an explicit year (use the current year/next occurrence — never a past year). If the user agrees on a specific time (e.g. 'Wednesday Oct 7 at 11:00'), set windowStart to that exact datetime and windowEnd to start + durationMinutes — do NOT expand to a full day or next-day midnight. Only use a broad day/range window when the user is still flexible. Prefer contactIds from CRM (find-or-create / list contacts first); use attendeeName only as a fallback when no contacts exist yet.

en.question: How are available appointment slots determined?
en.answer: Available slots are based on the provider's configured working hours, existing bookings, and buffer times between appointments. Only genuinely open slots are shown.

en.question: Can I check availability for a specific date?
en.answer: Yes, specify a date to see all open time slots for that day. You can also browse multiple days to find the most convenient option.

de.question: Wie werden verfügbare Terminslots ermittelt?
de.answer: Verfügbare Slots basieren auf den konfigurierten Arbeitszeiten des Anbieters, bestehenden Buchungen und Pufferzeiten zwischen Terminen. Es werden nur tatsächlich freie Slots angezeigt.

de.question: Kann ich die Verfügbarkeit für ein bestimmtes Datum prüfen?
de.answer: Ja, gib ein Datum an, um alle offenen Zeitslots für diesen Tag zu sehen. Du kannst auch mehrere Tage durchsuchen, um die passendste Option zu finden.

warp.bot: Use this only after running appointment-availability and the user has explicitly chosen a slot from the results. Never substitute this with direct calendar event creation — that skips booking policy, overlap checks, and attendee tracking. Always refer to bookings as 'appointments', never 'meetings'. Prefer contactIds for attendees (resolve via CRM find-or-create / list — never invent duplicates). Fall back to attendeeName/email only when no contacts exist. Build a descriptive title combining purpose and name (e.g. 'Consultation with Anna Schmidt'). Pass exact start time from the chosen slot as scheduledAt.
